editorial:
Imagine you are planning the perfect party, but someone is secretly trying to ruin your life. That is exactly what happens to Elena Cordova, a hardworking event planner who just wants to do a great job. She starts getting really close to a sweet girl named Azalea and her dad, Manny, who is a widower. Everything seems like it is going great until things start going wrong. Weird accidents happen, and it feels like someone is watching them from the shadows. You will feel the tension build as Elena starts to suspect her scary ex-boyfriend is back to haunt her and the people she loves.

The acting feels very real, and the mystery keeps you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the plot are a bit predictable, the scares are timed just right to keep you on the edge of your seat. If you love a good cat-and-mouse game, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the killer was not actually the ex-boyfriend, but someone much closer to the family who wanted the insurance money. After a scary fight in the house, Elena uses her planning skills to trick the killer into a trap. The police arrive just in time to arrest them. Elena, Azalea, and Manny finally find peace and decide to stay together as a new family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Lifetime-style mysteries and twisty thrillers.
